data.rationale: The proposal captures the core flow (Find a Park by State, select a state, open a park's links) but leaves out the park and section as parameters, adds an unneeded "open homepage" step and a vague "scroll" step, and says "etc." instead of naming the specific section link, so an automation would have to guess which park and link to open.
